entities.summary: Gergely Berzeviczy berzeviczei és kakaslomniczi was a Hungarian political economist and writer. He was follower of Adam Smith, one of the first political economists in the Kingdom of Hungary. He was an enthusiastic propagator of the High Tatras. He is renowned both in Hungary and Slovakia.
